Subject: Preflight: PO acceptance & invoice cutoff — Greenwave Systems

Laura / Marcus —

Quick preflight before I reach out to Greenwave procurement next week. They signaled intent to issue a PO this month tied to a July bookings recognition. Finance needs the signed PO mapped to the right contract and an invoice issued before the cutoff to include the booking in July numbers.

Can you confirm:
- The invoice cutoff for July bookings is end-of-day 2026-07-22 UTC (anything after will flow to August).
- We have a matching ruleset for PO numbers -> contract RWI-1178 (any exceptions?).
- Required fields on the PO (billing address, remit-to, tax ID) for us to process without manual follow-up.

I plan to ask procurement for the signed PO and the billing contact on Monday 7/13; want to make sure Finance has what they need to generate the invoice straight away.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Preflight: PO acceptance & invoice cutoff — Greenwave Systems

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for moving this forward. To keep both sides aligned for July recognition, two quick asks before we create the invoice:

1) Can you confirm the PO number and attach the signed PO (we typically need a PDF with signature)?
2) Please confirm the remit-to/billing email for receiving the invoice (accounting@greenwave.com or a different address).
3) Are there any internal invoice fields your AP system requires (PO line items, GL codes, department)?

Target timeline from our side: once we receive the signed PO and confirm mapping to contract RWI-1178, Finance will prepare the invoice. To be included in July bookings, we need to issue the invoice by the close-of-day 2026-07-22 UTC. If your AP needs a different cadence, tell us and we'll flag for recognition.

Attached is a draft invoice template and a short checklist for PO acceptance.

Attachments: [Attachment: proforma_invoice_template.xlsx (xlsx)], [Attachment: po-acceptance-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

Appreciate it —
Rishi
Director, Sales Ops

Thanks for the heads up. Attached is our signed PO (PO 4532). Billing should go to accounting@greenwave.com. Our AP system does prefer a PO field populated and a single line item referencing the subscription term; GL codes are optional.

We can get you an internal reference if needed but PO 4532 should be sufficient. Please send the invoice to accounting@greenwave.com once you have the mapped contract info.

Rishi —

Good to see the signed PO. A few internal notes for the billing run and revenue ops: 

- Confirmed cutoff: 2026-07-22 23:59 UTC for July recognition. We will include invoices dated on or before that timestamp in July bookings.
- PO 4532 maps to contract RWI-1178; no special exceptions.
- Required PO fields: vendor name, PO number, remit-to email, billing address. GL codes are optional as Elena said.
- Action items: Marcus to create invoice draft -> Rishi to validate mapping -> Marcus to submit to accounting@greenwave.com with reference INV-RWI-1178-07016.

I'll add the checklist to the HubSpot deal and tag the accounting contact (link below). If any of the fields arrive incomplete, please flag immediately; manual corrections after cutoff will push the recognition to August.

Related: https://hubspot.company/contacts/Greenwave-RWI-1178

Laura Bennett
